name: Half Blood
source:
When your hometown falls under the rule of a ruthless half-blood king, who will you turn to?
As King Zack expands his tyranny, it’s up to you and your companions to uncover the truth and put an end to his reign. Your only lead is a legendary warrior who once defeated him.
Outcast and driven by revenge, journey through bustling cities and forgotten ruins, growing stronger and closer as a team.
When the final battle comes, will you be ready?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.halfblood&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
